description_for_model: Use this to search SNKRS CART, an India-only store for authentic Nike, Jordan, Adidas, New Balance and Crocs sneakers. Prices are in INR and shoe sizes are UK sizes. Product URLs are https://www.snkrscart.com/products/<slug>. For per-size prices, stock and cart links prefer the MCP server at https://www.snkrscart.com/mcp. Buyers check out and pay on snkrscart.com themselves.
